CONVICTION_THRESHOLD = 5            # Modif mars 2026 (était 7)
FACTOR_POSITION_PCT  = 2.0          # 2 % du NAV pour FactorAgent
MICRO_POSITION_PCT   = 1.0          # 1 % du NAV pour MicrostructureAgent


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BrokerAdapter Protocol
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class BrokerAdapter(Protocol):
    slippage_model: float

    def execute_order(self, conn, order_id, instrument_id, side, quantity,
                      order_type, limit_price, current_price): ...


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paper Broker
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class PaperBroker:
    def __init__(self, slippage_pct: float = 0.001, fee_per_share: float = 0.005):
        self.slippage_pct = slippage_pct
        self.fee_per_share = fee_per_share

    def _calculate_fill_price(self, price: float, side: str) -> float:
        if side == "buy":
            return round(price * (1 + self.slippage_pct), 4)
        else:
            return round(price * (1 - self.slippage_pct), 4)

    def execute_order(self, conn, order_id, instrument_id, side, quantity,
                      order_type, limit_price, current_price) -> dict:
        fill_price = self._calculate_fill_price(current_price, side)
        slippage   = abs(fill_price - current_price) * quantity
        fees       = round(quantity * self.fee_per_share, 4)
        filled_at  = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()

        if order_type == "limit" and limit_price is not None:
            if side == "buy" and current_price > limit_price:
                return {"success": False, "reason": "Limit price not reached (buy above limit)"}
            if side == "sell" and current_price < limit_price:
                return {"success": False, "reason": "Limit price not reached (sell below limit)"}

        cur = conn.execute(
            """INSERT INTO fills (order_id, fill_price, fill_quantity, slippage, fees, filled_at)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
            (order_id, fill_price, quantity, round(slippage, 4), fees, filled_at)
        )
        fill_id = cur.lastrowid

        conn.execute("UPDATE orders SET status = 'filled' WHERE id = ?", (order_id,))

        self._update_position(conn, instrument_id, side, quantity, fill_price)

        trade_value = quantity * fill_price
        if side == "buy":
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE portfolio_state SET cash = cash - ? - ? WHERE id = 1",
                (trade_value, fees)
            )
        else:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE portfolio_state SET cash = cash + ? - ? WHERE id = 1",
                (trade_value, fees)
            )

        refresh_portfolio_state(conn)

        log_event(conn, "order_filled", "fill", fill_id, {
            "order_id": order_id, "instrument_id": instrument_id, "side": side,
            "quantity": quantity, "fill_price": fill_price,
            "slippage": round(slippage, 4), "fees": fees,
        }, agent="PaperBroker")

        return {
            "success": True, "fill_id": fill_id, "fill_price": fill_price,
            "fill_quantity": quantity, "slippage": round(slippage, 4),
            "fees": fees, "filled_at": filled_at,
        }

    def _update_position(self, conn, instrument_id, side, quantity, fill_price):
        existing = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, quantity, avg_cost FROM portfolio_positions WHERE instrument_id = ?",
            (instrument_id,)
        ).fetchone()

        if side == "buy":
            if existing:
                old_qty  = existing["quantity"]
                old_cost = existing["avg_cost"]
                new_qty  = old_qty + quantity
                new_cost = (old_qty * old_cost + quantity * fill_price) / new_qty
                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE portfolio_positions
                       SET quantity = ?, avg_cost = ?, current_price = ?,
                           unrealized_pnl = (? - ?) * ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
                       WHERE instrument_id = ?""",
                    (new_qty, round(new_cost, 4), fill_price,
                     fill_price, round(new_cost, 4), new_qty, instrument_id)
                )
            else:
                conn.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO portfolio_positions
                           (instrument_id, quantity, avg_cost, current_price, unrealized_pnl, weight_pct)
                       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0)""",
                    (instrument_id, quantity, round(fill_price, 4), fill_price)
                )

        else:  # sell
            if existing:
                new_qty = existing["quantity"] - quantity
                if new_qty <= 0:
                    conn.execute(
                        "DELETE FROM portfolio_positions WHERE instrument_id = ?",
                        (instrument_id,)
                    )
                else:
                    conn.execute(
                        """UPDATE portfolio_positions
                           SET quantity = ?, current_price = ?,
                               unrealized_pnl = (? - avg_cost) * ?,
                               updated_at = datetime('now')
                           WHERE instrument_id = ?""",
                        (new_qty, fill_price, fill_price, new_qty, instrument_id)
                    )
            # Pas de position existante → ne fait rien (risk_engine devrait bloquer amont)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper : position détenue ?
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_position_qty(conn: sqlite3.Connection, ticker: str) -> float:
    """Retourne la quantité détenue (0 si pas de position)."""
    row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT pp.quantity FROM portfolio_positions pp
           JOIN instruments i ON i.id = pp.instrument_id
           WHERE i.ticker = ?""",
        (ticker,)
    ).fetchone()
    return row["quantity"] if row else 0.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Execution Cycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DEFAULT_BROKER = PaperBroker(slippage_pct=0.001, fee_per_share=0.005)


def create_and_execute_order(conn, instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity,
                              order_type="market", limit_price=None,
                              broker=DEFAULT_BROKER) -> dict:
    price_row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT p.close FROM prices p
           JOIN instruments i ON i.id = p.instrument_id
           WHERE p.instrument_id = ?
           ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1""",
        (instrument_id,)
    ).fetchone()

    if not price_row:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "No price data for instrument"}

    current_price   = price_row[0]
    effective_price = limit_price if (order_type == "limit" and limit_price) else current_price

    risk_result = check_order(conn, instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity, effective_price)

    order_id = conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO orders
               (instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity, order_type, limit_price,
                status, risk_check_result)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
        (instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity, order_type, limit_price,
         "pending_validation" if risk_result["approved"] else "rejected",
         json.dumps(risk_result))
    ).lastrowid

    log_event(conn, "order_created", "order", order_id, {
        "instrument_id": instrument_id, "side": side, "quantity": quantity,
        "risk_action": risk_result["action"],
    }, agent="ExecutionEngine")

    if not risk_result["approved"]:
        conn.execute("UPDATE orders SET status = 'rejected' WHERE id = ?", (order_id,))
        return {
            "success": False, "order_id": order_id,
            "reason": "Risk check rejected order", "risk_check": risk_result,
        }

    approved_qty = risk_result["approved_quantity"]
    conn.execute("UPDATE orders SET quantity = ? WHERE id = ?",
                 (approved_qty, order_id))

    return {
        "success": True, "order_id": order_id,
        "status": "pending_validation", "risk_check": risk_result,
    }


# =============================================================================
# TARGET WEIGHTS — table portfolio_targets (v6.1)
# =============================================================================
# v6.1 : on persiste les targets dans une vraie table portfolio_targets.
# Schéma : (ticker UNIQUE, target_weight_pct REAL, active INTEGER, source TEXT,
#           updated_at TEXT). Seed automatique si la table est vide.
# =============================================================================

DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS = {
    # Valeurs alignées avec ce qu'affiche l'UI "Portfolio idéal" (mai 2026).
    # Modifiables à chaud via POST /api/targets ou directement en SQL.
    "META": 2.0,
    "LINK": 1.0,
    "ETH": 0.8,
    "BTC": 1.0,
}


def _ensure_portfolio_targets_table(conn) -> None:
    """Crée la table portfolio_targets si absente et seed les valeurs par défaut.

    Idempotent : peut être appelé à chaque cycle, ne touche pas aux données
    existantes. Le seed n'a lieu qu'à la toute première exécution
    (table fraîchement créée et vide).
    """
    try:
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolio_targets (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                ticker TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                target_weight_pct REAL NOT NULL,
                active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                source TEXT DEFAULT 'manual',
                updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            )
        """)
        conn.commit()

        # Seed uniquement si vide
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM portfolio_targets"
        ).fetchone()
        n_existing = row["n"] if row else 0
        if n_existing == 0:
            conn.executemany(
                """INSERT INTO portfolio_targets
                   (ticker, target_weight_pct, active, source)
                   VALUES (?, ?, 1, 'seed_v6_1')""",
                [(t, w) for t, w in DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS.items()],
            )
            conn.commit()
            print(f"[targets] Table portfolio_targets seed\u00e9e avec "
                  f"{len(DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS)} tickers : "
                  f"{', '.join(DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS.keys())}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[targets] WARN : impossible de cr\u00e9er/seeder portfolio_targets : {e}")


def _load_target_weights(conn) -> dict:
    """Récupère les target_weights actifs depuis portfolio_targets.

    Retourne un dict {ticker: pct} ou {} si rien de trouvable.
    Ordre de priorité :
      1) Table portfolio_targets (source de vérité v6.1+)
      2) Fallback : colonne target_weights_json dans theses (legacy)
    """
    # Assurance : la table existe (idempotent, pas coûteux)
    _ensure_portfolio_targets_table(conn)

    # Source 1 — table dédiée (priorité absolue)
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT ticker, target_weight_pct FROM portfolio_targets
               WHERE active = 1 AND target_weight_pct IS NOT NULL"""
        ).fetchall()
        if rows:
            return {r["ticker"]: float(r["target_weight_pct"]) for r in rows}
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Source 2 — fallback legacy depuis theses
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT target_weights_json FROM theses "
            "WHERE target_weights_json IS NOT NULL "
            "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
        ).fetchone()
        if row and row[0]:
            return json.loads(row[0])
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {}


def set_target_weight(conn, ticker: str, target_pct: float,
                     source: str = "manual") -> dict:
    """Helper public : insère ou met à jour le target d'un ticker.

    Utilisable depuis un endpoint API (ex. POST /api/targets) ou un script.
    Retourne l'état après écriture.
    """
    _ensure_portfolio_targets_table(conn)
    conn.execute("""
        INSERT INTO portfolio_targets (ticker, target_weight_pct, active, source, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, datetime('now'))
        ON CONFLICT(ticker) DO UPDATE SET
          target_weight_pct = excluded.target_weight_pct,
          active            = 1,
          source            = excluded.source,
          updated_at        = datetime('now')
    """, (ticker.upper().strip(), float(target_pct), source))
    conn.commit()
    return {
        "ticker": ticker.upper().strip(),
        "target_weight_pct": float(target_pct),
        "source": source,
    }



def _build_target_gap_proposals(conn, total_value, existing_proposals, regime):
    """v6.4 — Génère des propositions synthétiques pour combler l'écart entre
    portfolio_targets (cibles de PortfolioConstructionAgent) et le portefeuille
    actuel.

    Pipeline :
      1. Lit portfolio_targets WHERE active=1
      2. Pour chaque ticker, calcule cible_pct − actuel_pct
      3. Si |delta| > TARGET_GAP_MIN_DELTA_PCT, crée une proposition synthétique
      4. Si un agent tactique a déjà proposé le même ticker du même côté, fusionne
         (garde le max des deux qty_pct) au lieu de doublonner.

    Args:
        conn : sqlite3.Connection
        total_value : NAV courant (float)
        existing_proposals : liste des propositions déjà générées par les agents
        regime : 'BUILD' | 'MAINTAIN' | 'REBALANCE'

    Returns:
        (synthetic_proposals, merged_proposals, stats) :
          * synthetic_proposals : nouvelles propositions à ajouter au flux
          * merged_proposals    : existing_proposals modifiées in-place (pour info)
          * stats : dict {n_buy_inj, n_sell_inj, n_merged, n_skipped_small, gap_total_pct}
    """
    stats = {
        "n_buy_inj": 0, "n_sell_inj": 0, "n_merged": 0,
        "n_skipped_small": 0, "gap_total_pct": 0.0,
        "n_conflict_resolved": 0,
    }
    synthetic = []

    # 1. Charger targets actifs
    targets = _load_target_weights(conn)
    if not targets:
        print("[target_gap] aucune cible active dans portfolio_targets — skip")
        return synthetic, existing_proposals, stats

    # 2. Charger positions actuelles + prix
    positions = {}
    prices = {}
    for r in conn.execute("""
        SELECT i.ticker, p.quantity, p.current_price
        FROM portfolio_positions p
        JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
    """).fetchall():
        tkr = r["ticker"]
        qty = float(r["quantity"] or 0)
        cp  = float(r["current_price"] or 0)
        positions[tkr] = qty
        if cp > 0:
            prices[tkr] = cp

    # 3. Compléter prices pour les tickers cibles non détenus
    missing_tkrs = [t for t in targets.keys() if t not in prices]
    if missing_tkrs:
        for tkr in missing_tkrs:
            row = conn.execute("""
                SELECT p.close FROM prices p
                JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
                WHERE i.ticker = ?
                ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1
            """, (tkr,)).fetchone()
            if row and row[0]:
                prices[tkr] = float(row[0])

    # 4. Index des propositions existantes par ticker (pour merge)
    by_ticker_side = {}  # (ticker, side) -> proposal
    for p in existing_proposals:
        key = (p.get("ticker"), p.get("side"))
        by_ticker_side[key] = p

    # 5. Boucle sur chaque cible
    for ticker, target_pct in targets.items():
        price = prices.get(ticker)
        if not price or price <= 0:
            print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} skip : pas de prix disponible")
            continue

        held_qty   = positions.get(ticker, 0.0)
        actual_val = held_qty * price
        actual_pct = (actual_val / total_value) * 100 if total_value > 0 else 0
        delta_pct  = target_pct - actual_pct
        stats["gap_total_pct"] += abs(delta_pct)

        # Seuil minimal
        if abs(delta_pct) < TARGET_GAP_MIN_DELTA_PCT:
            stats["n_skipped_small"] += 1
            continue

        side = "buy" if delta_pct > 0 else "sell"
        # quantité cible : on comble le delta entier (choix utilisateur : 1 cycle)
        delta_val = abs(delta_pct) / 100 * total_value
        qty       = math.floor(delta_val / price)

        # Pour les SELL, plafonner à la position détenue
        if side == "sell":
            qty = int(min(qty, math.floor(held_qty)))

        if qty <= 0:
            print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} skip : qty=0 (delta={delta_pct:+.2f}% px={price:.2f})")
            continue

        # Créer la proposition synthétique
        synth_prop = {
            "thesis_id":     None,                    # pas de thèse rattachée
            "ticker":        ticker,
            "side":          side,
            "quantity_pct":  abs(delta_pct),          # delta en % NAV
            "source":        "TargetGap",             # tag
            "agent_type":    "PortfolioConstructionAgent",
            "conviction":    TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION,   # 8.0
            "conviction_raw": TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION,
            "regime_mult":   1.0,                     # pas d'atténuation régime
            "reason":        f"Gap to target {delta_pct:+.2f}% NAV (cible {target_pct:.2f}% − actuel {actual_pct:.2f}%)",
        }
        if side == "sell":
            synth_prop["max_qty"] = held_qty

        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
        # v6.5 CLEANUP : résolution des conflits de sens opposé
        # Si TargetGap veut SELL et qu'un agent a un BUY (ou vice-versa),
        # on résout par conviction AVANT que le Reconciler ne le voie.
        # Cela évite les doublons Order/Fill observés en v6.4.
        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
        opposite_side = "buy" if side == "sell" else "sell"
        conflict_prop = by_ticker_side.get((ticker, opposite_side))
        if conflict_prop is not None:
            agent_conv = float(conflict_prop.get("conviction", 0))
            tg_conv    = float(synth_prop["conviction"])  # TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION = 8.0
            if tg_conv > agent_conv:
                # TargetGap gagne : on KEEP le sens TargetGap
                # et on RETIRE la proposition agent conflictuelle du flux
                existing_proposals[:] = [
                    p for p in existing_proposals if p is not conflict_prop
                ]
                # Mettre aussi à jour l'index local
                by_ticker_side.pop((ticker, opposite_side), None)
                stats["n_conflict_resolved"] += 1
                print(
                    f"[target_gap_dedup]   {ticker:<6} conflit SELL/BUY résolu "
                    f"en faveur TargetGap (conv TG={tg_conv:.1f} > agent={agent_conv:.1f}) "
                    f"— proposition agent {conflict_prop.get('source','?')} retirée"
                )
            else:
                # Agent gagne : on SKIP le SELL synthétique
                stats["n_conflict_resolved"] += 1
                print(
                    f"[target_gap_dedup]   {ticker:<6} conflit SELL/BUY résolu "
                    f"en faveur agent (conv agent={agent_conv:.1f} >= TG={tg_conv:.1f}) "
                    f"— SELL synthétique TargetGap ignoré"
                )
                continue  # on ne pousse pas le SELL synthétique

        # Fusion : si un agent a déjà proposé le même ticker/side, on garde le max
        existing = by_ticker_side.get((ticker, side))
        if existing is not None:
            existing_qty_pct = float(existing.get("quantity_pct", 0))
            if abs(delta_pct) > existing_qty_pct:
                # le gap est plus gros que ce que l'agent propose → élever la qty
                existing["quantity_pct"] = abs(delta_pct)
                existing["reason"] = (existing.get("reason") or "") + f" | merged TargetGap +{delta_pct:+.2f}%"
                # garder un floor de conviction à 8.0 pour bénéficier des overrides
                if float(existing.get("conviction", 0)) < TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION:
                    existing["conviction"] = TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION
                stats["n_merged"] += 1
                print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} {side.upper()} MERGED → qty_pct={abs(delta_pct):.2f}% (agent={existing.get('source')})")
            else:
                stats["n_merged"] += 1
                print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} {side.upper()} déjà couvert par {existing.get('source')} (qty_pct={existing_qty_pct:.2f}% >= delta {abs(delta_pct):.2f}%)")
            continue

        # Sinon, on ajoute une nouvelle proposition synthétique
        synthetic.append(synth_prop)
        if side == "buy":
            stats["n_buy_inj"] += 1
        else:
            stats["n_sell_inj"] += 1
        print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} {side.upper():<4} qty={qty:<6} ({abs(delta_pct):+.2f}% NAV) — {synth_prop['reason']}")

    return synthetic, existing_proposals, stats


def _build_reconciler_context(conn, total_value, proposals):
    """Construit current_positions, prices, target_weights pour le Reconciler."""
    current_pos = {}
    prices = {}

    # Positions actuelles + leur current_price
    for r in conn.execute("""
        SELECT i.ticker, p.quantity, p.current_price
        FROM portfolio_positions p
        JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
    """).fetchall():
        try:
            current_pos[r["ticker"]] = r["quantity"] or 0
            if r["current_price"]:
                prices[r["ticker"]] = r["current_price"]
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError):
            pass

    # Compléter prices avec les derniers close pour les tickers proposés non détenus
    proposed_tickers = {p["ticker"] for p in proposals if p.get("ticker")}
    missing = proposed_tickers - set(prices.keys())
    for tkr in missing:
        row = conn.execute("""
            SELECT p.close FROM prices p
            JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
            WHERE i.ticker = ?
            ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1
        """, (tkr,)).fetchone()
        if row:
            prices[tkr] = row[0]

    target_weights = _load_target_weights(conn)
    return current_pos, prices, target_weights


def _enrich_proposals_with_conviction(proposals, agent_results):
    """Ajoute conviction dans chaque proposal en lookant agent_results."""
    # Index : thesis_id → conviction
    thesis_conv = {}
    for agent_key in ("factor", "microstructure", "crypto", "altdata"):
        for item in agent_results.get(agent_key, []) or []:
            tid = item.get("thesis_id")
            if tid is not None:
                thesis_conv[tid] = item.get("conviction", 0)

    for p in proposals:
        if "conviction" not in p:
            p["conviction"] = thesis_conv.get(p.get("thesis_id"), 0)
    return proposals


def run_decision_cycle(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> dict:
    """
    Decision cycle PATCHED 2026-05-22 + 2026-05-24 :
      - conviction >= 5
      - FactorAgent overweight  → BUY (toujours)
      - FactorAgent underweight → SELL UNIQUEMENT si position détenue
      - MicrostructureAgent sell signal → SELL UNIQUEMENT si position détenue
      - CryptoAgent strong_buy/buy/accumulate → BUY ; sell/take_profit → SELL si tenu
      - OrderReconciler : déduplique conflits, drop bruit < 0,3 % NAV,
        bypass conviction >= 9
    """
    from agents import run_all_agents
    from memo_generator import generate_ic_memo

    print("[execution] Starting decision cycle...")

    # Step 1: Run agents
    agent_results = run_all_agents(conn)
    conn.commit()

    proposals = []

    # ----- FactorAgent -----
    for item in agent_results.get("factor", []):
        conv   = item.get("conviction", 0)
        tilt   = item.get("tilt")
        ticker = item.get("ticker")
        if conv < CONVICTION_THRESHOLD:
            continue

        if tilt == "overweight":
            proposals.append({
                "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                "side": "buy", "quantity_pct": FACTOR_POSITION_PCT,
                "source": "FactorAgent",
                "conviction": conv,
            })
        elif tilt == "underweight":
            held_qty = get_position_qty(conn, ticker)
            if held_qty > 0:
                proposals.append({
                    "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                    "side": "sell", "quantity_pct": FACTOR_POSITION_PCT,
                    "source": "FactorAgent",
                    "max_qty": held_qty,
                    "conviction": conv,
                })
            else:
                print(f"[execution] Skip SELL {ticker}: no position held (underweight thesis ignored)")

    # ----- MicrostructureAgent -----
    for item in agent_results.get("microstructure", []):
        conv   = item.get("conviction", 0)
        signal = item.get("signal", "").lower()
        ticker = item.get("ticker")
        if conv < CONVICTION_THRESHOLD:
            continue

        if "buy" in signal:
            proposals.append({
                "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                "side": "buy", "quantity_pct": MICRO_POSITION_PCT,
                "source": "MicrostructureAgent",
                "conviction": conv,
            })
        elif "sell" in signal or "reduce" in signal:
            held_qty = get_position_qty(conn, ticker)
            if held_qty > 0:
                proposals.append({
                    "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                    "side": "sell", "quantity_pct": MICRO_POSITION_PCT,
                    "source": "MicrostructureAgent",
                    "max_qty": held_qty,
                    "conviction": conv,
                })
            else:
                print(f"[execution] Skip SELL {ticker}: no position held (micro signal ignored)")

    # ----- CryptoAgent -----
    for item in agent_results.get("crypto", []):
        conv   = item.get("conviction", 0)
        signal = item.get("signal", "").lower()
        ticker = item.get("ticker")
        if conv < CONVICTION_THRESHOLD:
            continue

        if signal in ("strong_buy", "buy", "accumulate"):
            qty_pct = MICRO_POSITION_PCT * 2 if signal == "strong_buy" else MICRO_POSITION_PCT
            proposals.append({
                "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                "side": "buy", "quantity_pct": qty_pct,
                "source": "CryptoAgent",
                "conviction": conv,
            })
        elif signal in ("sell", "take_profit"):
            held_qty = get_position_qty(conn, ticker)
            if held_qty > 0:
                proposals.append({
                    "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                    "side": "sell", "quantity_pct": MICRO_POSITION_PCT,
                    "source": "CryptoAgent",
                    "max_qty": held_qty,
                    "conviction": conv,
                })
            else:
                print(f"[execution] Skip SELL {ticker}: no position held (crypto signal ignored)")

    # Step 2 : Compute NAV
    portfolio_state = conn.execute(
        "SELECT total_value, cash FROM portfolio_state WHERE id = 1"
    ).fetchone()
    total_value = portfolio_state["total_value"] if portfolio_state else 1_000_000

    # cycle_id partagé par ExitAgent, PortfolioRegime et Reconciler
    cycle_id = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.3 : DÉTECTION DU RÉGIME DE PORTEFEUILLE (NEW — v6)
    # ============================================================
    # Calcule BUILD / MAINTAIN / REBALANCE selon % investi du NAV.
    # Sera appliqué après l'ExitAgent (pour atténuer les exit proposals)
    # et avant le Reconciler.
    try:
        regime_info = detect_portfolio_regime(conn)
        print(f"[regime] Régime détecté : {regime_info['regime']} "
              f"(invested={regime_info['invested_pct']:.2f} %, "
              f"NAV={regime_info['nav']:.0f}, cash={regime_info['cash']:.0f}, "
              f"positions={regime_info['n_positions']})")
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[regime] ERREUR détection — fallback MAINTAIN : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        regime_info = {"regime": "MAINTAIN", "invested_pct": 50.0,
                       "nav": total_value, "cash": 0.0, "n_positions": 0}

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.4 : EXIT AGENT (patch 2026-05-24 b / v5)
    # ============================================================
    # Examine les positions ouvertes et émet SL / TP / DRIFT / TIME_DECAY.
    # En régime BUILD, les exit proposals seront atténués par le mult ×0.3
    # appliqué au Step 2.45.
    try:
        targets_cache = _load_target_weights(conn)
        exit_proposals = run_exit_agent(
            conn, cycle_id=cycle_id,
            targets=targets_cache, nav=total_value
        )
        if exit_proposals:
            print(f"[execution] ExitAgent : {len(exit_proposals)} signal(s) ajouté(s)")
            proposals.extend(exit_proposals)
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[exit_agent] ERREUR (non bloquant) : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.42 : TARGET GAP SYNTHESIZER (NEW — v6.4)
    # ============================================================
    # Lit portfolio_targets et génère des propositions synthétiques pour
    # combler tout écart > 0.30 % NAV avec les positions actuelles.
    # Doit tourner APRÈS les agents (pour pouvoir fusionner avec leurs
    # propositions) et AVANT le régime (pour bénéficier des caps).
    try:
        gap_synth, _, gap_stats = _build_target_gap_proposals(
            conn, total_value, proposals,
            regime=regime_info.get("regime", "MAINTAIN"),
        )
        if gap_synth:
            proposals.extend(gap_synth)
        print(
            f"[target_gap] {gap_stats['n_buy_inj']} BUY synthétiques, "
            f"{gap_stats['n_sell_inj']} SELL synthétiques, "
            f"{gap_stats['n_merged']} fusions avec agents, "
            f"{gap_stats['n_skipped_small']} écart(s) sous le seuil 0.30 % — "
            f"gap total |Δ|={gap_stats['gap_total_pct']:.2f} % — "
            f"{gap_stats['n_conflict_resolved']} conflit(s) BUY/SELL résolu(s) [v6.5]"
        )
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[target_gap] ERREUR (non bloquant) : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.45 : APPLICATION DU RÉGIME (NEW — v6)
    # ============================================================
    # 1) Enrichit chaque proposal avec sa conviction brute (depuis agent_results)
    # 2) Applique le multiplicateur (régime × agent_type) sur la conviction
    # 3) Plafonne la taille des SELL en % de la position détenue
    # 4) Plafonne la taille des BUY au target × overshoot
    # 5) Log dans regime_log
    try:
        proposals = _enrich_proposals_with_conviction(proposals, agent_results)
        targets_for_regime = _load_target_weights(conn) or {}
        regime_stats = apply_regime_to_proposals(
            conn, proposals, regime_info, target_weights=targets_for_regime
        )
        log_regime(conn, cycle_id, regime_info, regime_stats,
                   notes=f"v6 — {regime_stats['n_attenuated']} att., "
                         f"{regime_stats['n_sell_capped']} SELL capped, "
                         f"{regime_stats['n_buy_capped']} BUY capped")
        if regime_stats["n_sell_capped"] or regime_stats["n_buy_capped"] \
           or regime_stats["n_attenuated"]:
            print(f"[regime] {regime_info['regime']} appliqué : "
                  f"{regime_stats['n_attenuated']} convictions ajustées, "
                  f"{regime_stats['n_sell_capped']} SELL plafonnés, "
                  f"{regime_stats['n_buy_capped']} BUY plafonnés")
            # Trace détaillée des proposals modifiés
            for p in proposals:
                if p.get("cap_reason"):
                    print(f"[regime]   {p.get('ticker')} {p.get('side','').upper()}"
                          f" — {p['cap_reason']}")
                if abs(float(p.get("regime_mult", 1.0)) - 1.0) > 1e-9:
                    print(f"[regime]   {p.get('ticker')} {p.get('side','').upper()}"
                          f" {p.get('agent_type','?')} : conv "
                          f"{p.get('conviction_raw',0):.1f} × {p.get('regime_mult'):.2f}"
                          f" = {p.get('conviction',0):.2f}")
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[regime] ERREUR application (non bloquant) : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.5 : RECONCILIATION (patch 2026-05-24 a)
    # ============================================================
    proposals_before = len(proposals)
    try:
        # _enrich_proposals_with_conviction est idempotent — déjà appelé en 2.45
        # mais on le rappelle au cas où des proposals auraient été ajoutés ailleurs
        proposals = _enrich_proposals_with_conviction(proposals, agent_results)
        current_pos, prices_map, target_weights = _build_reconciler_context(
            conn, total_value, proposals
        )

        reconciler = OrderReconciler(
            conn=conn,
            nav=total_value,
            current_positions=current_pos,
            target_weights=target_weights,
            prices=prices_map,
            regime=regime_info.get("regime", "MAINTAIN"),  # v6.1 : Reconciler régime-aware
        )
        proposals = reconciler.reconcile(proposals, cycle_id=cycle_id)
        print(
            f"[reconciler] {proposals_before} proposals → {len(proposals)} après réconciliation"
            f" (cycle_id={cycle_id})"
        )
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[reconciler] ERREUR : {e} — fallback : proposals inchangées")
        traceback.print_exc()
    # ============================================================

    # Step 3 & 4 : create pending orders
    _ = cycle_id  # cycle_id déjà défini plus haut (Step 2)
    pending_orders = []
    for proposal in proposals:
        inst = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE ticker = ?", (proposal["ticker"],)
        ).fetchone()
        if not inst:
            continue

        price_row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT close FROM prices WHERE instrument_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
            (inst["id"],)
        ).fetchone()
        if not price_row:
            continue

        price = price_row[0]
        target_value = total_value * (proposal["quantity_pct"] / 100)
        quantity = math.floor(target_value / price)

        # FIX : pour les SELL, plafonner à la position détenue
        if proposal["side"] == "sell" and "max_qty" in proposal:
            quantity = int(min(quantity, math.floor(proposal["max_qty"])))

        if quantity <= 0:
            continue

        # v6.4 — si la proposition est synthétique (TargetGap), créer une
        # thèse PortfolioConstructionAgent pour garder un audit propre
        if proposal.get("thesis_id") is None and proposal.get("source") == "TargetGap":
            synth_thesis_id = conn.execute("""
                INSERT INTO theses
                  (instrument_id, agent_type, thesis_text, conviction_score,
                   horizon, key_drivers, proposed_action, status,
                   created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active',
                        datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
            """, (
                inst["id"],
                "PortfolioConstructionAgent",
                f"TargetGap synth: {proposal.get('reason', '')}",
                float(proposal.get("conviction", TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION)),
                "medium",
                "portfolio_targets gap",
                f"{proposal['side'].upper()} {proposal['ticker']} "
                f"to close target gap ({proposal.get('quantity_pct', 0):.2f}% NAV)",
            )).lastrowid
            proposal["thesis_id"] = synth_thesis_id
            conn.commit()
            print(f"[target_gap]   synth thesis id={synth_thesis_id} créée pour {proposal['ticker']} {proposal['side'].upper()}")

        result = create_and_execute_order(
            conn, inst["id"], proposal["thesis_id"],
            proposal["side"], quantity, broker=DEFAULT_BROKER
        )
        pending_orders.append({
            "ticker": proposal["ticker"], "side": proposal["side"],
            "quantity": quantity, "status": result.get("status", "rejected"),
            "order_id": result.get("order_id"), "result": result,
        })
        conn.commit()

    memo_id = generate_ic_memo(conn, agent_results)
    conn.commit()

    orders_pending = len([o for o in pending_orders if o["status"] == "pending_validation"])
    print(f"[execution] Cycle complete: {orders_pending} orders pending validation, memo_id={memo_id}")

    return {
        "agent_results": {
            "macro_stance":  agent_results["macro"].get("stance"),
            "factor_theses": len(agent_results["factor"]),
            "micro_theses":  len(agent_results["microstructure"]),
            "alt_theses":    len(agent_results["altdata"]),
        },
        "orders_pending": orders_pending,
        "orders": pending_orders,
        "memo_id": memo_id,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from models import init_db
    init_db()
    conn = get_db()
    result = run_decision_cycle(conn)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"Decision cycle result: {result}")



===== portfolio_construction_agent.py =====

"""
portfolio_construction_agent_jalon2.py — Jalon 2
=================================================

PortfolioConstructionAgent v2 — détermine dynamiquement portfolio_targets
à partir d'une fonction d'utilité multi-facteurs.

JALON 2 : activation des composantes Macro, Vol Penalty et Diversification.

Composantes actives :
  C (conviction)     : ACTIVE depuis Jalon 1 (conviction moyenne pondérée)
  M (macro affinity) : ACTIVE depuis Jalon 2 (régime portefeuille → bucket)
  V (vol penalty)    : ACTIVE depuis Jalon 2 (sigma 90j normalisée)
  D (diversif)       : ACTIVE depuis Jalon 2 (corrélation avec positions)
  R (realized)       : Stub — activé en Jalon 3

Fonction d'utilité :
  score_total = w_conv*C + w_real*R + w_macro*M + w_diversif*D - lambda_vol*V
  (toutes composantes normalisées via z-score + sigmoid avant composition)

Cycle de vie :
  1. Charge target_universe (tickers candidats actifs)
  2. Charge target_construction_config (pondérations)
  3. Détection régime macro via regime_log
  4. Pour chaque ticker → calcule composantes brutes (C, M, V, D)
  5. Normalise (z-score → sigmoid)
  6. Score composite S_i
  7. Exclusion : tickers sous seuil → target = 0
  8. Allocation soft-max bornée par le budget de régime
  9. Application caps/floors par ticker
 10. Smoothing vs targets précédents (anti-churn)
 11. Écriture portfolio_targets + snapshot portfolio_targets_history

Compatible avec execution_engine v6.5 :
  - Lit/écrit portfolio_targets (mêmes colonnes que v6.1+)
  - Respecte le flag agent_decided=0 → ne touche pas aux targets manuels

Usage standalone :
    py -3.13 portfolio_construction_agent_jalon2.py
    py -3.13 portfolio_construction_agent_jalon2.py --dry-run
    py -3.13 portfolio_construction_agent_jalon2.py --force

Usage programmatique :
    from portfolio_construction_agent_jalon2 import run_construction_agent
    result = run_construction_agent(conn, cycle_id="20260524-150000",
                                    regime_info={"regime":"BUILD"})
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import sqlite3
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

# Numpy facultatif (fallback pur Python si absent)
try:
    import numpy as np
    _NUMPY_OK = True
except ImportError:
    _NUMPY_OK = False
    import statistics as _stats


# =============================================================================
# Configuration par défaut (insérée dans target_construction_config si absente)

DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    # Pondérations des composantes (somme libre, c'est le score qui est borné)
    "w_conviction":   0.40,
    "w_realized":     0.15,
    "w_macro":        0.20,
    "w_diversif":     0.15,
    "lambda_vol":     0.10,
    # Température softmax — élevé = concentré, faible = diversifié
    "beta_temp":      3.0,
    # Budget total alloué selon le régime portefeuille
    "budget_build":     0.30,   # max 30 % NAV alloués en BUILD
    "budget_maintain":  0.70,
    "budget_rebalance": 0.90,
    # Seuil d'inclusion : sous cette valeur de S_i, ticker exclu
    "min_score_inclusion": 0.30,
    # Lissage anti-churn : variation max par recalcul, en points de % NAV
    "smoothing_max_delta_pct": 0.50,
    # Demi-vie pour pondération fraîcheur conviction (en jours)
    "conviction_halflife_days": 14.0,
    # Fenêtre d'analyse des thèses
    "conviction_lookback_days": 90,
    # Fenêtre d'analyse des prix pour vol + diversif (en jours)
    "price_lookback_days": 90,
    # Jalon 2 : macro, vol et diversif activés ; realized réservé Jalon 3
    "enable_realized":    0,  # Jalon 3
    "enable_macro":       1,  # ACTIVE Jalon 2

}

# Univers par défaut (seeded si target_universe vide)

# =============================================================================
# Bootstrap : tables + config + univers
# =============================================================================
def ensure_construction_tables(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Crée toutes les tables du Jalon 1 (idempotent)."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS target_universe (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            ticker TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            asset_class TEXT,
            sector TEXT,
            is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            max_weight_pct REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.0,
            min_weight_pct REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
            added_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
        )
    """)
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS target_construction_config (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            params_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
        )
    """)
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolio_targets_history (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            cycle_id TEXT,
            ticker TEXT NOT NULL,
            score REAL,
            target_weight_pct REAL,
            prev_target_weight_pct REAL,
            components_json TEXT,
            regime TEXT,
            included INTEGER,
            cap_floor_applied TEXT,
            created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
        )
    """)
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pt_hist_snapshot
        ON portfolio_targets_history(snapshot_id, ticker)
    """)
    # Extension portfolio_targets (idempotent — ALTER fail si col existe)
    for col_def in [
        "ALTER TABLE portfolio_targets ADD COLUMN snapshot_id TEXT",
        "ALTER TABLE portfolio_targets ADD COLUMN score REAL",
        "ALTER TABLE portfolio_targets ADD COLUMN agent_decided INTEGER DEFAULT 0",
    ]:
        try:
            conn.execute(col_def)
        except sqlite3.OperationalError:
            pass  # colonne existe déjà
    conn.commit()


def seed_universe_if_empty(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    """Seed l'univers par défaut si target_universe est vide. Renvoie n inséré."""
    row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM target_universe").fetchone()
    if row and row["n"] > 0:
        return 0
    conn.executemany("""
        INSERT INTO target_universe
          (ticker, asset_class, sector, max_weight_pct, min_weight_pct)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, DEFAULT_UNIVERSE)
    conn.commit()
    return len(DEFAULT_UNIVERSE)


def seed_config_if_empty(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
    """Seed la config par défaut si target_construction_config vide. Renvoie True si seed."""
    row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM target_construction_config WHERE id=1").fetchone()
    if row:
        return False
    conn.execute("""
        INSERT INTO target_construction_config (id, params_json)
        VALUES (1, ?)
    """, (json.dumps(DEFAULT_CONFIG),))
    conn.commit()
    return True


def load_config(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> dict:
    """Charge la config (avec fallback DEFAULT_CONFIG pour les clés manquantes)."""
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT params_json FROM target_construction_config WHERE id=1"
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    try:
        params = json.loads(row["params_json"]) if row["params_json"] else {}
    except Exception:
        params = {}
    merged = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    merged.update(params)
    return merged


def load_universe(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[dict]:
    """Renvoie la liste des tickers actifs de l'univers."""
    rows = conn.execute("""
        SELECT ticker, asset_class, sector,
               max_weight_pct, min_weight_pct
        FROM target_universe
        WHERE is_active = 1
        ORDER BY ticker
    """).fetchall()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


# =============================================================================
# Composantes du score (Jalon 1 : conviction seule, autres stubs)
# =============================================================================
def compute_avg_conviction(conn: sqlite3.Connection, ticker: str,
                            halflife_days: float = 14.0,
                            lookback_days: int = 90) -> float:
    """Conviction moyenne pondérée par fraîcheur (décroissance exponentielle).

    Lecture : table theses, jointure instruments.ticker.
    Renvoie 0 si aucune thèse trouvée.
    """
    decay = math.log(2) / max(halflife_days, 1.0)  # taux pour demi-vie
    rows = conn.execute("""
        SELECT t.conviction_score AS conv,
               julianday('now') - julianday(t.created_at) AS age_days
        FROM theses t
        JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
        WHERE i.ticker = ?
          AND t.created_at >= date('now', ?)
          AND t.conviction_score IS NOT NULL
    """, (ticker, f"-{int(lookback_days)} days")).fetchall()

    if not rows:
        return 0.0

    num = 0.0
    den = 0.0
    for r in rows:
        try:
            conv = float(r["conv"] or 0)
            age = max(float(r["age_days"] or 0), 0.0)
            w = math.exp(-decay * age)
            num += conv * w
            den += w
        except Exception:
            continue
    return num / den if den > 0 else 0.0


def compute_realized_score(conn, ticker: str, days: int = 90) -> float:
    """Stub Jalon 3 — renvoie 0 (R non calculé avant Jalon 3)."""
    return 0.0


# =============================================================================
# Composante M — Macro Affinity (Jalon 2)
# =============================================================================

def _get_portfolio_macro_env(conn) -> str:
    """Détecte l'environnement macro via le dernier régime portefeuille loggé.

    Mapping :
      BUILD | MAINTAIN  → risk_on
      REBALANCE          → risk_off
      (aucune ligne)     → neutral

    Retourne : 'risk_on' | 'risk_off' | 'neutral'
    """
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT regime FROM regime_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            print("[macro_affinity] Aucun régime en base — environnement 'neutral'")
            return "neutral"
        regime = (row["regime"] if hasattr(row, '__getitem__') else row[0] or "").upper()
        if regime in ("BUILD", "MAINTAIN"):
            return "risk_on"
        if regime == "REBALANCE":
            return "risk_off"
        return "neutral"
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[macro_affinity] Erreur lecture regime_log : {e} — fallback 'neutral'")
        return "neutral"


def _ticker_macro_bucket(asset_class: str, sector: str) -> str:
    """Classe un ticker dans un bucket macro selon asset_class et sector.

    Règles :
      asset_class='crypto' OU sector in (Technology, Consumer Discretionary)
          → risk_on
      sector in (Healthcare, Energy, Financials)
          → risk_off
      asset_class='etf' OU sector='Broad Market'
          → neutral
      sinon
          → neutral (fallback)

    Retourne : 'risk_on' | 'risk_off' | 'neutral'
    """
    ac  = (asset_class or "").lower().strip()
    sec = (sector or "").strip()

    # crypto ou tech / conso discrétionnaire → risk_on
    if ac == "crypto":
        return "risk_on"
    if sec in ("Technology", "Consumer Discretionary", "tech", "auto_tech",
               "smart_chain", "oracle", "store_value", "consumer"):
        return "risk_on"
    # defensif → risk_off
    if sec in ("Healthcare", "Energy", "Financials"):
        return "risk_off"
    # ETF / Marché large → neutral
    if ac == "etf" or sec in ("Broad Market", "broad_market"):
        return "neutral"
    return "neutral"


def compute_macro_affinity(
    conn,
    ticker: str,
    asset_class: str,
    sector: str = "",
    env: str = "",
) -> tuple[float, str, str]:
    """Score d'affinité macro pour un ticker.

    Args:
        conn        : connexion SQLite
        ticker      : ticker du titre
        asset_class : classe d'actif (ex: 'equity', 'crypto', 'etf')
        sector      : secteur (ex: 'Technology', 'Healthcare')
        env         : environnement macro ('risk_on' | 'risk_off' | 'neutral')
                      Si vide, détecté automatiquement via regime_log.

    Returns:
        (score, bucket, env) où score ∈ {0.0, 0.5, 1.0}
    """
    if not env:
        env = _get_portfolio_macro_env(conn)

    bucket = _ticker_macro_bucket(asset_class, sector)

    # Calcul du score
    if env == "neutral" or bucket == "neutral":
        score = 0.5
    elif env == bucket:
        score = 1.0
    else:
        score = 0.0

    return score, bucket, env


# =============================================================================
# Composante V — Vol Penalty (Jalon 2)
# =============================================================================

def _fetch_log_returns(conn, ticker: str, days: int = 90) -> list[float]:
    """Retourne les log-rendements journaliers des 'days' derniers closes.

    Retourne une liste vide si moins de 2 prix disponibles.
    """
    rows = conn.execute("""
        SELECT p.close
        FROM prices p
        JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
        WHERE i.ticker = ?
          AND p.close IS NOT NULL AND p.close > 0
        ORDER BY p.date DESC
        LIMIT ?
    """, (ticker, days + 1)).fetchall()

    closes = [float(r[0] if not hasattr(r, '__getitem__') else r["close"])
              for r in rows]
    if len(closes) < 2:
        return []
    # Du plus ancien au plus récent
    closes.reverse()
    return [math.log(closes[i] / closes[i - 1])
            for i in range(1, len(closes))]


def _std_of(values: list[float]) -> float:
    """Ecart-type population. Retourne 0 si <2 éléments."""
    n = len(values)
    if n < 2:
        return 0.0
    if _NUMPY_OK:
        return float(np.std(values, ddof=0))
    mean = sum(values) / n
    var  = sum((v - mean) ** 2 for v in values) / n
    return math.sqrt(var)


def compute_vol_penalty(
    conn,
    ticker: str,
    days: int = 90,
    lambda_vol: float = 0.10,
    universe_sigma: float = 0.0,
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Calcule la pénalité de volatilité pour un ticker.

    Formule :
      sigma   = ecart-type des log-rendements sur 'days' jours
      sigma_n = sigma / universe_sigma_moyen  (normalisé universe)
      score_v = exp(-lambda_vol * sigma_n)

    Args:
        conn           : connexion SQLite
        ticker         : ticker
        days           : fenêtre en jours
        lambda_vol     : paramètre de pénalité (config)
        universe_sigma : sigma moyen de l'univers (passer 0 pour fallback)

    Returns:
        (score_vol_raw_sigma, sigma) où sigma est le vol non normalisé
        Le score final utilise universe_sigma externe pour normaliser.
    """
    returns = _fetch_log_returns(conn, ticker, days)
    sigma = _std_of(returns) if returns else 0.0
    return sigma


def _compute_vol_score(sigma: float, universe_sigma: float,
                       lambda_vol: float) -> float:
    """Calcule le score vol normalisé ∈ (0, 1] pour un ticker.

    sigma_n = sigma / universe_sigma  (ou 1.0 si universe_sigma=0)
    score   = exp(-lambda_vol * sigma_n)
    """
    if universe_sigma < 1e-9:
        sigma_n = 1.0
    else:
        sigma_n = sigma / universe_sigma
    return math.exp(-lambda_vol * sigma_n)


# =============================================================================
# Composante D — Diversification (Jalon 2)
# =============================================================================

def _pearson_corr(xs: list[float], ys: list[float]) -> float:
    """Corrélation de Pearson entre deux séries de même longueur.

    Retourne 0 si n < 2 ou variance nulle.
    """
    n = len(xs)
    if n < 2:
        return 0.0
    if _NUMPY_OK:
        r = float(np.corrcoef(xs, ys)[0, 1])
        return r if math.isfinite(r) else 0.0
    mx = sum(xs) / n
    my = sum(ys) / n
    num = sum((x - mx) * (y - my) for x, y in zip(xs, ys))
    sx  = math.sqrt(sum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs))
    sy  = math.sqrt(sum((y - my) ** 2 for y in ys))
    if sx < 1e-9 or sy < 1e-9:
        return 0.0
    r = num / (sx * sy)
    return max(-1.0, min(1.0, r))


def compute_diversification(
    conn,
    ticker: str,
    held_tickers: list[str],
    days: int = 90,
) -> float:
    """Score de diversification d'un candidat vis-à-vis des positions ouvertes.

    Formule :
      corr_avg = moyenne des corrélations (Pearson) avec chaque ticker détenu
      score    = 1 - max(0, corr_avg)

    Cas limites :
      - held_tickers vide         → score = 1.0 (aucune position, pas de risque)
      - corr neg ou zéro          → score = 1.0
      - corr parfaite (=1.0)      → score = 0.0
    """
    if not held_tickers:
        return 1.0

    candidate_returns = _fetch_log_returns(conn, ticker, days)
    if not candidate_returns:
        return 0.5  # pas assez de prix — neutre

    corrs = []
    for h in held_tickers:
        if h == ticker:
            continue
        held_returns = _fetch_log_returns(conn, h, days)
        # Aligner les deux séries sur la longueur commune
        n = min(len(candidate_returns), len(held_returns))
        if n < 5:
            continue
        r = _pearson_corr(candidate_returns[-n:], held_returns[-n:])
        corrs.append(r)

    if not corrs:
        return 1.0  # aucun chevauchement de données — diversif maximale
    corr_avg = sum(corrs) / len(corrs)
    return 1.0 - max(0.0, corr_avg)


# =============================================================================
# Normalisation
# =============================================================================
def _sigmoid(x: float) -> float:
    if x >= 0:
        z = math.exp(-x)
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + z)
    z = math.exp(x)
    return z / (1.0 + z)


def normalize_components(rows: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """Z-score + sigmoid pour ramener chaque composante sur [0, 1].

    Mute rows en place en remplaçant 'C', 'R', 'M', 'D', 'V' par leur version
    normalisée. Si l'univers a une variance nulle sur une composante, on
    renvoie 0.5 (neutre) pour tous.
    """
    for key in ("C", "R", "M", "D", "V"):
        vals = [r[key] for r in rows]
        n = len(vals)
        if n == 0:
            continue
        mean = sum(vals) / n
        var = sum((v - mean) ** 2 for v in vals) / n
        std = math.sqrt(var)
        for r in rows:
            if std < 1e-9:
                r[key] = 0.5
            else:
                z = (r[key] - mean) / std
                r[key] = _sigmoid(z)
    return rows


# =============================================================================
# Allocation soft-max bornée
# =============================================================================
def softmax_allocate(rows: list[dict], budget: float, beta: float) -> dict:
    """Distribue le budget total entre les tickers selon e^(β·S_i).

    Renvoie {ticker: weight_pct} où sum(weight_pct) ≈ budget * 100.
    """
    if not rows:
        return {}
    # Normalisation numérique du softmax
    max_s = max(r["S"] for r in rows)
    exps = [(r["ticker"], math.exp(beta * (r["S"] - max_s))) for r in rows]
    total = sum(e for _, e in exps)
    if total <= 0:
        return {t: 0.0 for t, _ in exps}
    return {t: (e / total) * budget * 100.0 for t, e in exps}


def apply_caps_floors(allocations: dict, universe: list[dict],
                      scores: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """Plafonne au max_weight_pct, applique le min_weight_pct si éligible.

    Renvoie (allocations_ajustées, cap_floor_log) où cap_floor_log[ticker] est
    une chaîne descriptive du clipping appliqué (ou '' si rien).
    """
    caps = {u["ticker"]: u for u in universe}
    log = {}
    adjusted = {}
    for ticker, w in allocations.items():
        u = caps.get(ticker)
        if not u:
            adjusted[ticker] = w
            log[ticker] = ""
            continue
        max_w = float(u["max_weight_pct"] or 5.0)
        min_w = float(u["min_weight_pct"] or 0.5)
        msg = ""
        if w > max_w:
            msg = f"CAP {w:.2f}→{max_w:.2f}"
            w = max_w
        elif 0 < w < min_w:
            # Si le score le justifie (inclus), on remonte au plancher
            if scores.get(ticker, 0) > 0:
                msg = f"FLOOR {w:.2f}→{min_w:.2f}"
                w = min_w
        adjusted[ticker] = w
        log[ticker] = msg
    return adjusted, log


def smooth_vs_previous(new_targets: dict, prev_targets: dict,
                       max_delta_pct: float) -> dict:
    """Limite la variation par recalcul à max_delta_pct (anti-churn).

    Pour chaque ticker : new_target = clamp(new, prev ± max_delta)
    Les tickers absents de prev_targets démarrent à 0 → variation = new.
    """
    smoothed = {}
    for ticker, new_w in new_targets.items():
        prev_w = float(prev_targets.get(ticker, 0.0))
        delta = new_w - prev_w
        if abs(delta) > max_delta_pct:
            smoothed[ticker] = prev_w + math.copysign(max_delta_pct, delta)
        else:
            smoothed[ticker] = new_w
    return smoothed


# =============================================================================
# Persistance
# =============================================================================
def _load_current_targets_split(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """Renvoie (manual_targets, agent_targets).

    manual_targets : tickers verrouillés (agent_decided = 0 ou NULL)
    agent_targets  : tickers gérés par l'algo (agent_decided = 1)
    """
    manual = {}
    agent = {}
    try:
        rows = conn.execute("""
            SELECT ticker, target_weight_pct,
                   COALESCE(agent_decided, 0) AS agent_decided
            FROM portfolio_targets
            WHERE active = 1
        """).fetchall()
        for r in rows:
            if r["agent_decided"]:
                agent[r["ticker"]] = float(r["target_weight_pct"])
            else:
                manual[r["ticker"]] = float(r["target_weight_pct"])
    except sqlite3.OperationalError:
        pass
    return manual, agent


def write_targets(conn: sqlite3.Connection, targets: dict, scores: dict,
                  snapshot_id: str) -> int:
    """Écrit les nouveaux targets dans portfolio_targets (UPSERT).

    Respect du flag agent_decided : on n'écrase QUE les tickers dont
    agent_decided = 1 (ou ligne nouvelle). Les tickers manuels (agent_decided=0)
    ne sont jamais touchés ici — l'agent les "voit" mais ne les modifie pas.
    """
    n_written = 0
    for ticker, w in targets.items():
        # Vérifier flag actuel
        row = conn.execute("""
            SELECT COALESCE(agent_decided, 0) AS ad
            FROM portfolio_targets WHERE ticker = ?
        """, (ticker,)).fetchone()
        is_manual = bool(row) and not row["ad"]
        if is_manual:
            continue  # on respecte un target verrouillé manuel

        conn.execute("""
            INSERT INTO portfolio_targets
              (ticker, target_weight_pct, active, source, updated_at,
               snapshot_id, score, agent_decided)
            VALUES (?, ?, 1, 'agent_v1', datetime('now'), ?, ?, 1)
            ON CONFLICT(ticker) DO UPDATE SET
              target_weight_pct = excluded.target_weight_pct,
              active            = 1,
              source            = 'agent_v1',
              updated_at        = datetime('now'),
              snapshot_id       = excluded.snapshot_id,
              score             = excluded.score,
              agent_decided     = 1
        """, (ticker, round(float(w), 4),
              snapshot_id, round(float(scores.get(ticker, 0)), 4)))
        n_written += 1
    # Désactivation des targets agent-decided dont le ticker n'est plus dans la
    # nouvelle allocation (exclusion par le score)
    if targets:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in targets)
        conn.execute(f"""
            UPDATE portfolio_targets
            SET active = 0, updated_at = datetime('now')
            WHERE agent_decided = 1
              AND ticker NOT IN ({placeholders})
              AND active = 1
        """, list(targets.keys()))
    conn.commit()
    return n_written


def write_history(conn: sqlite3.Connection, snapshot_id: str,
                  cycle_id: Optional[str], regime: str,
                  rows: list[dict], targets: dict,
                  prev_targets: dict, cap_floor_log: dict,
                  included_tickers: set) -> None:
    """Snapshot complet pour audit : 1 ligne par ticker évalué."""
    payload = []
    for r in rows:
        t = r["ticker"]
        components = {
            "C_norm": round(r["C"], 4),
            "R_norm": round(r["R"], 4),
            "M_norm": round(r["M"], 4),
            "D_norm": round(r["D"], 4),
            "V_norm": round(r["V"], 4),
            "C_raw": round(r.get("C_raw", 0), 4),
        }
        payload.append((
            snapshot_id, str(cycle_id or ""), t,
            round(float(r["S"]), 4),
            round(float(targets.get(t, 0)), 4),
            round(float(prev_targets.get(t, 0)), 4),
            json.dumps(components),
            regime,
            1 if t in included_tickers else 0,
            cap_floor_log.get(t, ""),
        ))
    if payload:
        conn.executemany("""
            INSERT INTO portfolio_targets_history
              (snapshot_id, cycle_id, ticker, score,
               target_weight_pct, prev_target_weight_pct,
               components_json, regime, included, cap_floor_applied)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, payload)
        conn.commit()


# =============================================================================
# ORCHESTRATION
# =============================================================================
def run_construction_agent(conn: sqlite3.Connection,
                           cycle_id: Optional[str] = None,
                           regime_info: Optional[dict] = None,
                           dry_run: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Point d'entrée principal.

    Args:
        conn        : connexion SQLite (row_factory = Row recommandé)
        cycle_id    : id du cycle déclencheur (pour traçabilité)
        regime_info : {'regime':'BUILD'|'MAINTAIN'|'REBALANCE', ...}
        dry_run     : si True, calcule mais n'écrit ni portfolio_targets
                      ni portfolio_targets_history (juste un rapport)

    Returns:
        dict avec snapshot_id, n_targets, allocations finales, scores.
    """
    # Bootstrap
    ensure_construction_tables(conn)
    seeded_u = seed_universe_if_empty(conn)
    seeded_c = seed_config_if_empty(conn)
    if seeded_u:
        print(f"[construction] Univers seedé : {seeded_u} tickers")
    if seeded_c:
        print(f"[construction] Config seedée par défaut")

    config = load_config(conn)
    universe = load_universe(conn)
    if not universe:
        print("[construction] ALERTE : target_universe vide ou tout inactif")
        return {"snapshot_id": None, "n_targets": 0, "allocations": {}, "scores": {}}

    regime = (regime_info or {}).get("regime", "MAINTAIN").upper()
    budget = {
        "BUILD":     float(config["budget_build"]),
        "MAINTAIN":  float(config["budget_maintain"]),
        "REBALANCE": float(config["budget_rebalance"]),
    }.get(regime, float(config["budget_maintain"]))

    # ---- Préparation Jalon 2 ----
    halflife = float(config["conviction_halflife_days"])
    lookback = int(config["conviction_lookback_days"])
    price_days = int(config.get("price_lookback_days", 90))
    lambda_vol = float(config["lambda_vol"])

    # Détection de l'environnement macro (une seule fois pour tout l'univers)
    macro_env = _get_portfolio_macro_env(conn) if config["enable_macro"] else "neutral"
    print(f"[pca_jalon2] Environnement macro détecté : {macro_env}")

    # Tickers actuellement détenus (pour diversification)
    held_tickers = []
    try:
        held_rows = conn.execute("""
            SELECT i.ticker
            FROM portfolio_positions pp
            JOIN instruments i ON i.id = pp.instrument_id
            WHERE pp.quantity > 0
        """).fetchall()
        held_tickers = [r["ticker"] for r in held_rows]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[pca_jalon2] Impossible de charger les positions : {e}")
    print(f"[pca_jalon2] Positions détenues ({len(held_tickers)}) : {held_tickers}")

    # Vol : calcul des sigmas bruts pour TOUS les tickers (pour normalisation univers)
    sigma_map: dict[str, float] = {}
    if config["enable_vol_penalty"]:
        for u in universe:
            sigma_map[u["ticker"]] = compute_vol_penalty(conn, u["ticker"], price_days)
        sigmas_valid = [s for s in sigma_map.values() if s > 0]
        universe_sigma = (sum(sigmas_valid) / len(sigmas_valid)) if sigmas_valid else 1.0
        print(f"[pca_jalon2] Sigma univers moyen : {universe_sigma:.6f} "
              f"(sur {len(sigmas_valid)} tickers avec prix)")
    else:
        universe_sigma = 1.0

    # ---- Calcul composantes brutes ----
    rows = []
    for u in universe:
        t = u["ticker"]
        ac  = u.get("asset_class", "")
        sec = u.get("sector", "")

        C_raw = compute_avg_conviction(conn, t, halflife, lookback)
        R = compute_realized_score(conn, t) if config["enable_realized"] else 0.0

        # Macro affinity (Jalon 2)
        if config["enable_macro"]:
            M_score, M_bucket, _ = compute_macro_affinity(
                conn, t, ac, sector=sec, env=macro_env
            )
            M = M_score
        else:
            M_bucket = "neutral"
            M = 0.0

        # Vol penalty (Jalon 2) — on utilise le sigma déjà calculé
        if config["enable_vol_penalty"]:
            sigma_t = sigma_map.get(t, 0.0)
            V = _compute_vol_score(sigma_t, universe_sigma, lambda_vol)
        else:
            sigma_t = 0.0
            V = 0.0

        # Diversification (Jalon 2)
        D = (
            compute_diversification(conn, t, held_tickers, price_days)
            if config["enable_diversif"]
            else 0.0
        )

        rows.append({
            "ticker":    t,
            "asset_class": ac,
            "sector":    sec,
            "C":         C_raw, "C_raw": C_raw,
            "R":         R,
            "M":         M, "M_bucket": M_bucket,
            "D":         D,
            "V":         V, "sigma":    sigma_map.get(t, 0.0),
        })

    # ---- Normalisation ----
    rows = normalize_components(rows)

    # ---- Score composite ----
    for r in rows:
        r["S"] = (
            float(config["w_conviction"]) * r["C"]
            + float(config["w_realized"])   * r["R"]
            + float(config["w_macro"])      * r["M"]
            + float(config["w_diversif"])   * r["D"]
            - float(config["lambda_vol"])   * r["V"]
        )

    # ---- Exclusion : ne garder que les tickers au-dessus du seuil ----
    min_inclusion = float(config["min_score_inclusion"])
    included = [r for r in rows if r["S"] >= min_inclusion]
    included_tickers = {r["ticker"] for r in included}

    if not included:
        # Fallback Jalon 1 : si AUCUN ticker n'a de thèses récentes, on prend
        # quand même le top-3 par score brut (sinon premier run = portfolio vide)
        print("[construction] Aucun ticker au-dessus du seuil → fallback top-3 scores")
        included = sorted(rows, key=lambda x: -x["S"])[:3]
        included_tickers = {r["ticker"] for r in included}

    # ---- Allocation soft-max ----
    raw_alloc = softmax_allocate(included, budget, float(config["beta_temp"]))

    # ---- Caps & floors ----
    scores_map = {r["ticker"]: r["S"] for r in rows}
    capped_alloc, cap_log = apply_caps_floors(raw_alloc, universe, scores_map)

    # ---- Smoothing vs targets actuels ----
    manual_targets, prev_agent_targets = _load_current_targets_split(conn)
    smoothed = smooth_vs_previous(
        capped_alloc, prev_agent_targets,
        float(config["smoothing_max_delta_pct"])
    )

    # ---- Snapshot id ----
    snapshot_id = f"snap-{datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"

    # ---- Écriture ----
    n_written = 0
    if not dry_run:
        n_written = write_targets(conn, smoothed, scores_map, snapshot_id)
        # Snapshot complet (TOUS les tickers, pas seulement les inclus)
        write_history(conn, snapshot_id, cycle_id, regime,
                      rows, smoothed, prev_agent_targets,
                      cap_log, included_tickers)
    else:
        print("[construction] DRY-RUN — aucune écriture")

    # ---- Rapport ----
    total_alloc = sum(smoothed.values())
    print(f"\n=== PortfolioConstructionAgent v2 — Jalon 2 ===")
    print(f"Régime      : {regime}  (budget {budget*100:.1f} % NAV)")
    print(f"Macro env   : {macro_env}")
    print(f"Univers     : {len(universe)} tickers")
    print(f"Inclus      : {len(included)} tickers (seuil score ≥ {min_inclusion})")
    print(f"Cibles agent: {n_written} écrites ({'dry-run' if dry_run else 'persisté'})")
    print(f"Manuels     : {len(manual_targets)} tickers respectés")
    print(f"Allocation  : {total_alloc:.2f} % NAV (cash résiduel ≈ "
          f"{100 - total_alloc - sum(manual_targets.values()):.2f} %)")
    print()
    print(f"{'TICKER':<8} {'SCORE':>7} {'C_raw':>7} {'M':>6} {'V':>6} {'D':>6}"
          f" {'BUCKET':<10} {'SIGMA':>9} {'PREV%':>7} {'NEW%':>7}  CAP/FLOOR")
    print("-" * 95)
    for r in sorted(rows, key=lambda x: -x["S"]):
        t = r["ticker"]
        new  = smoothed.get(t, 0.0)
        prev = prev_agent_targets.get(t, 0.0)
        marker = "  *" if t in included_tickers else "   "
        print(f"{t:<6}{marker} {r['S']:>7.3f} {r['C_raw']:>7.2f} "
              f"{r.get('M', 0):>6.3f} {r.get('V', 0):>6.3f} {r.get('D', 0):>6.3f} "
              f"{r.get('M_bucket', '?'):<10} {r.get('sigma', 0):>9.6f} "
              f"{prev:>6.2f}% {new:>6.2f}%  {cap_log.get(t, '')}")

    if manual_targets:
        print(f"\nTargets MANUELS (non touchés) :")
        for t, w in sorted(manual_targets.items()):
            print(f"  {t:<6} {w:.2f} %")

    return {
        "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
        "n_targets": n_written,
        "allocations": smoothed,
        "scores": scores_map,
        "regime": regime,
        "budget_pct": budget * 100,
        "dry_run": dry_run,
        "macro_env": macro_env,
        "n_tickers_evaluated": len(universe),
        "n_tickers_included": len(included),
        "targets": [
            {"ticker": t, "weight_pct": round(w, 4),
             "score": round(scores_map.get(t, 0), 4)}
            for t, w in smoothed.items()
        ],
    }


# =============================================================================
# Helper public : reset des cibles agent (pour repartir d'une feuille blanche)
# =============================================================================
def reset_agent_targets(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    """Désactive toutes les cibles posées par l'agent. Garde les manuels."""
    cur = conn.execute("""
        UPDATE portfolio_targets
        SET active = 0, updated_at = datetime('now')
        WHERE agent_decided = 1
    """)
    conn.commit()
    return cur.rowcount


# =============================================================================
# Entrée CLI
# =============================================================================
def _detect_db_path() -> Path:
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    for cand in (here / "thesium.db", Path("thesium.db").resolve()):
        if cand.exists():
            return cand
    return here / "thesium.db"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="PortfolioConstructionAgent v2 — Jalon 2"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                        help="Calcul sans écriture (ni portfolio_targets ni history)")
    parser.add_argument("--regime", default="BUILD",
                        choices=["BUILD", "MAINTAIN", "REBALANCE"],
                        help="Régime portefeuille à utiliser (défaut: BUILD)")
    parser.add_argument("--reset", action="store_true",
                        help="Désactive les cibles agent avant le run (manuels préservés)")
    parser.add_argument("--cycle-id", default=None,
                        help="cycle_id pour traçabilité dans le snapshot")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    db_path = _detect_db_path()
    if not db_path.exists():
        print(f"ERREUR : DB introuvable ({db_path}). Lance depuis ThesiumDesk/.")
        sys.exit(1)

    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_path))
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

    if args.reset:
        n = reset_agent_targets(conn)
        print(f"[construction] {n} cible(s) agent désactivée(s)")

    result = run_construction_agent(
        conn,
        cycle_id=args.cycle_id,
        regime_info={"regime": args.regime},
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    print(f"\n[construction] snapshot_id : {result['snapshot_id']}")
    conn.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
execution_engine.py — v6.5 — Paper-trading execution engine for Thesium.finance / Nextones Desk

PATCH 2026-05-22 — Corrections critiques :
  - SELL uniquement sur positions détenues (no involuntary short selling)
  - Conviction threshold = 5
  - FactorAgent : tilt overweight→BUY / underweight→SELL
  - Quantité SELL plafonnée à la position détenue

PATCH 2026-05-24 (a) — OrderReconciler intégré :
  - Conflits BUY+SELL sur même ticker → garde côté conviction max
  - Signaux <0,3 % NAV → DROP (bruit non rentable)
  - Ordres opposés au delta cible → DROP
  - Conviction >= 9 → BYPASS tous les filtres
  - Trace dans table cycle_reconciliation_log

PATCH 2026-05-24 (b) — ExitAgent intégré (v5) :
  - STOP-LOSS -5 % / TAKE-PROFIT +15 % / DRIFT 25 % / TIME-DECAY 30j (alerte)
  - Trace dans table exit_decisions_log

PATCH 2026-05-24 (c) — PortfolioRegime adaptatif (v6) :
  - Détecte régime BUILD / MAINTAIN / REBALANCE selon % investi du NAV
      * BUILD       : invested < 20 %  → privilégie LT, atténue ST, désactive Exit
      * MAINTAIN    : 20 ≤ invested < 80 % → comportement normal (×1.0 partout)
      * REBALANCE   : invested ≥ 80 %  → priorité au DRIFT, Micro pour timing
  - Multiplicateur de conviction par couple (régime × agent_type)
  - Plafonnement de la taille SELL en % de la position détenue (pas en % NAV)
      * BUILD : max 25 % de la position vendue par cycle
      * MAINTAIN : 50 % | REBALANCE : 100 %
  - Plafonnement des BUY au target × overshoot (BUILD ×1.1, MAINTAIN ×1.2, REBAL ×1.5)
  - Trace dans table regime_log (un row par cycle)

PATCH 2026-05-24 (d) — v6.1 — Fix Reconciler / target_weights persistants :
  - Création + auto-seed de la table portfolio_targets (LINK 1.0, ETH 0.8,
    META 2.0, BTC 1.0) la première fois que le moteur tourne
  - _load_target_weights() lit en priorité portfolio_targets (legacy theses
    en fallback) → fini les target=0 partout
  - OrderReconciler reçoit maintenant `regime` :
      * En BUILD, un BUY de conviction >= 6.0 peut by-passer le filtre
        "sens opposé au target" (le plafond BUY = target × 1.10 du Régime
        garde l'exposition sous contrôle)
  - Helper set_target_weight(conn, ticker, pct) pour brancher POST /api/targets

PATCH 2026-05-24 (e) — v6.2 — Déblocage accumulation BUILD :
  - MAX_OVERSHOOT_TARGET_MULT[BUILD] : 1.10 → 1.50 (accélère l'accumulation
    quand on est sous-investi globalement, même si un ticker individuel
    dépasse son target)
  - Plancher minimum BUY en BUILD : si un BUY conv >= 6.0 est plafonné sous
    MIN_BUY_PCT_FLOOR (0.35 % NAV), on remonte la qty à ce plancher pour
    éviter de dropper sur "signal trop petit" — indispensable pour les
    cryptos chères (ETH ~ 2100 $) avec un tout petit cap d'overshoot.
  - OrderReconciler : en BUILD avec qty >= 1 et conv >= 6.0, le filtre
    "signal trop petit" est by-passé (l'agent assume une petite ligne plutôt
    que rien). Loggué KEPT_BUILD_MIN_SIZE.

PATCH 2026-05-24 (f) — v6.3 — Déblocage final FILTRE 3 :
  - En BUILD avec conv >= 6.0, on n'applique plus "Portfolio d\u00e9j\u00e0 \u00e0 la cible".
    Rationale : en phase de construction (<20 % investi), on veut sur-pondérer
    les convictions fortes au-delà du target, et le ceiling target × 1.50 déjà
    appliqué par PortfolioRegime protege contre la sur-exposition.
  - Loggué KEPT_BUILD_ACCUMULATE.

PATCH 2026-05-24 (g) — v6.4 — TargetGap synthesizer :
  - Avant le Reconciler, on lit portfolio_targets (cibles de PortfolioConstructionAgent)
    et on calcule le delta = cible âˆ’ actuel pour CHAQUE ticker actif.
  - Pour chaque |delta| > TARGET_GAP_MIN_DELTA_PCT (0.30 % NAV), on injecte
    une proposition synthétique side=buy (gap positif) ou side=sell (gap négatif)
    de source='TargetGap', conviction=8.0, qty = delta entier en 1 cycle.
  - Si un agent tactique a déjà émis une proposition sur le même ticker dans
    le même sens, on FUSIONNE : on garde celle des deux qui a la plus grosse
    qty. Cela évite les doublons.
  - Le tag SELL synthétique est autorisé dans TOUS les régimes (rebalance
    strict vers la cible). Le BUY synthétique passe ensuite par les caps de
    PortfolioRegime et par le Reconciler comme n'importe quel autre BUY.
  - Loggué [target_gap] {n_buy_inj} BUY, {n_sell_inj} SELL, {n_merged} fusions.
  - Comble enfin l'écart entre portfolio_targets (10 tickers à 1.5 % chacun)
    et le portefeuille réel (3 positions META/LINK/ETH) sans dépendre des
    convictions des 6 agents tactiques.

PATCH 2026-05-24 (h) — v6.5 — Cleanup dédup BUY agents / SELL TargetGap :
  - Évite les doublons dans Orders & Fills observés en v6.4
  - Si TargetGap SELL et agent BUY conflictueux → résolution par conviction
    avant la phase Reconciler (au lieu de laisser le Reconciler dropper l'un)
